# Test fixtures

This directory is reserved for versioned test and product-reference documents.
No representative customer documents are currently committed. Tests generate
small synthetic documents; they are not a substitute for a licensed product
corpus.

Planned contents:

- Valid documents across every supported schema version (migration inputs)
- Malformed and adversarial documents for parser fuzzing
- Round-trip documents that must open and re-save without unintended change

When adding fixtures, record their source/schema version and license. Keep
adversarial parser inputs separate from valid product-reference documents.

## Committed fixtures

### `m0-editor-ui-v2.json`

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Source | Generated by `generate_m0_editor_ui.py` for this repository |
| License | MIT, same as the repository |
| Document schema version | 2 |
| Read by | `crates/tools/tests/m0_editor_ui.rs` |

A static Arabic-first editor screen at a 1440×900 viewport. It includes a
nested phone scene and layer tree, Arabic and Latin labels, seven generated
path-only SVG icons, and one generated product PNG. Run
`python tests/fixtures/generate_m0_editor_ui.py` to regenerate the deterministic
fixture and assets. Render references live under `tests/golden/m0-editor-ui.*`;
the image fingerprint records the visual review verdict, and regeneration
resets it until a human checks the new render.

### `coordinate-contract.v1.json`

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Source | Written for this repository (ADR-0002) |
| License | MIT, same as the repository |
| Schema version | 1 (fixture format, not the document schema) |
| Read by | `crates/core/tests/coordinate_goldens.rs` |

State the coordinate contract as data: each case lists a chain of transforms
from the outermost node to the innermost, the points it maps, and the SVG
`matrix(...)` value it exports. It is reviewed by hand, because changing a case
is a decision about the coordinate contract. The fixture is versioned by file
name, so a change to the contract adds `coordinate-contract.v2.json` rather than
editing this one in place.

### `document-v1-minimal.json`

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Source | Written for this repository |
| License | MIT, same as the repository |
| Document schema version | 1 |
| Read by | `crates/format/tests/schema_v2.rs` |

A v1 document: a page, one frame holding a shape and a text node, one declared
asset, and one unknown field on the frame. It is the migration input, so the
test can assert that a v1 file still opens, that its nodes keep the defaults of
their kind, and that the unknown field survives.

### `document-v2-styled.json`

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Source | Written for this repository |
| License | MIT, same as the repository |
| Document schema version | 2 |
| Read by | `crates/format/tests/schema_v2.rs` |

A v2 document with explicit properties on every kind: a flex frame, an ellipse
with a stroke and a non-uniform transform, an Arabic right-to-left text node,
and an image referring to the declared asset. It is also the source of the fuzz
corpus seed `fuzz/corpus/valid-styled-v2.swv`, produced with
`swotvibe-tools bundle pack`.
